blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent unified multimodal models aim to combine visual understanding and generation within a single model, yet effectively integrating the two capabilities remains challenging. Leveraging pretrained vision-language models offers a way to build on already learned multimodal knowledge, but making this knowledge effectively accessible to visual generation remains nontrivial. We find that a central challenge lies in the heterogeneous visual representations used for understanding and generation. To address this challenge, we introduce Integral, which converts a pretrained vision-language model into a unified multimodal model by constructing a shared visual representation space across the two capabilities. Integral implements this design through two complementary components. Abstraction Fusion constructs shared visual tokens by aggregating hierarchical representations from the frozen vision encoder, while Block-wise MoT introduces a lightweight generative stream that interacts with the vision-language model only at block boundaries. Our approach effectively preserves the pretrained understanding capability while extending it to strong visual generation. Controlled comparisons further demonstrate that sharing visual representations between understanding and generation substantially improves generative learning compared with using a separate visual representation space, despite comparable reconstruction fidelity. These results suggest that representations learned by pretrained vision-language models already provide an effective foundation for visual generation.
blocks.zh: 最近的统一的多式联运模式旨在将视觉理解和生成结合在一个单一模式中,但有效整合这两种能力仍然是一项挑战。 利用事先受过训练的视觉语言模型,为在已经学到的多模式知识基础上更上一层楼提供了一种方法,但使视觉一代能够有效地获得这种知识仍然是非三角性的。 我们认为,一个中心挑战在于用于理解和生成的各种视觉表现。 为了应对这一挑战,我们引入了Integrative(Integrative),通过在两种能力之间搭建一个共享的视觉表现空间,将预先训练的视觉语言模型转化为统一的多式联运模型. 综合通过两个互补部分实施这一设计。 抽象融合通过汇总来自冷冻视觉编码器的分级表示来构建共享视觉符号,而Block-wise MOT则引入了轻量级基因流,只在块边界上与视觉语言模型相互作用. 我们的方法有效地保留了事先训练好的理解能力,同时将其扩展到强大的视觉生成. 受控的比较进一步表明,尽管重建忠贞程度相当,但分享理解和世代之间的视觉表现,与使用单独的视觉表现空间相比,大大改进了基因学习。 这些结果表明,通过经过预先训练的视觉语言模型而获得的表述已经为视觉生成提供了有效的基础。

blocks.en:
Unifying multimodal understanding and generation within a single model has received growing attention in multimodal learning ( OpenAI, 2024 ; Team, 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2024 ) .
Such unification offers the potential for visual generation to leverage knowledge acquired through multimodal understanding ( OpenAI, 2024 ) .
However, jointly optimizing for understanding and generation remains challenging, as the two objectives can interfere with each other, potentially compromising understanding performance ( Hao et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026a ) .
To mitigate such interference, recent unified multimodal models (UMMs) introduce generation-specific capacity to create a separate pathway for visual generation ( Pan et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2025 ; Deng et al., 2025 ) .
Such specialization poses a challenge for the generation pathway to effectively leverage knowledge encoded in the understanding pathway.
blocks.zh:
在多式联运学习中,统一多式联运的理解和生成日益受到关注(OpenAI, 2024;Team, 2024; Chen等,2025b; Wang等,2024.).
这种统一为视觉生成提供了利用通过多模式理解获得的知识的潜力(OpenAI, 2024)。
然而,共同优化理解和生成仍然具有挑战性,因为这两个目标可能相互干扰,可能损害理解绩效(Hao等,2026;Ye等,2026;Liu等,2026a)。
为了减少这种干扰,最近的统一的多模式模式引入了针对不同世代的能力,为视觉生成创造出一条单独的路径(Pan等,2025;Shi等,2025;Deng等,2025)。
这种专业化给生成路径带来了挑战,难以有效地利用在理解路径中编码的知识。

blocks.en:
Prior work has explored architectural designs that connect pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) to generative pathways through learnable queries ( Pan et al., 2025 ) , feature conditioning ( Wu et al., 2026 ) , or shared attention ( Wang et al., 2026c ; Shen et al., 2026 ) .
While these approaches allow generative pathways to access pretrained VLM representations, they typically model generation in a separate, heterogeneous visual representation space, often defined by reconstruction-oriented VAEs ( Esser et al., 2024 ; Labs, 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025a ) .
Recent studies have highlighted the role of sharing visual representations in leveraging pretrained multimodal knowledge for generation ( Wu et al., 2025b ; Kang et al., 2026 ) .
However, directly using VLM representations for generation remains challenging, as their high-level features often lack the fine-grained information required for image reconstruction ( Chen et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) .
Adapting the vision encoder for reconstruction, in turn, can degrade its pretrained semantic capabilities ( Wu et al., 2025c ; Lin et al., 2025c ; Yue et al., 2026 ) .
This raises the question of whether rich representations learned by pretrained VLMs for multimodal understanding can also be leveraged for visual generation without compromising their understanding capabilities.
blocks.zh:
先前的工作探索了建筑设计,通过可学习的查询(Pan等人,2025年),特征调节(Wu等人,2026年),或共同关注(Wang等人,2026年c; 沈等, 2026 (中文(简体) ).
虽然这些方法允许基因途径获得预先训练的VLM表示,但它们通常在一个单独的、相异的视觉表示空间中进行模型生成,往往由面向重建的VAEs所定义(Esser等,2024;Labs,2024;Wu等,2025a)。
最近的研究强调了分享视觉表现在利用经过预先培训的多模式知识促进一代的作用(Wu等,2025b;Kang等,2026)。
然而,在一代人中直接使用VLM表示仍然具有挑战性,因为其高层次特征往往缺乏图像重建所需的精细信息(Chen等,2025a; 张等,2025a. ).
改造重建的视觉编码器又会降低其预先训练的语义能力(Wu等,2025c;Lin等,2025c;Yue等,2026).
这就提出了这样一个问题,即通过预先培训的关于多式联运的自愿清单获得的丰富表述是否也可以用于视觉生成而不损害其理解能力。

blocks.en:
In this work, we propose Integral , a unified multimodal modeling approach that extends a pretrained vision-language model with visual generation in a shared visual representation space while preserving its understanding capabilities. Our analysis suggests that a key bottleneck in adapting pretrained vision encoders for reconstruction while preserving their semantic quality may lie in the retention of low-level features in deeper layers, potentially interfering with progressive semantic abstraction (Sec. 2.1 ).
Based on this observation, we introduce Abstraction Fusion (AF), which aggregates representations across multiple abstraction levels of the frozen vision encoder into shared visual tokens z z for understanding and generation without altering the pretrained hierarchy. To efficiently leverage the understanding pathway for generation in this token space, we further introduce Block-wise Mixture-of-Transformers (Block-wise MoT), a lightweight generative architecture that conditions on the VLM’s internal representations at block boundaries.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们提议采用统一的多模式模式模式,在共同的视觉表现空间中,将预先训练的视觉语言模式扩展为视觉生成,同时保留其理解能力。 我们的分析表明,在为重建调整预先训练的视觉编码器的同时保留其语义质量方面的一个关键瓶颈可能在于在更深层中保留低等特征,可能干扰渐进语义抽象(第2.1节)。
基于这一观察,我们引入了"抽象融合"(AF),它将被冻结的视觉编码器的多抽象层次的表达集合成共享的视觉符号z z来理解和生成,而不会改变预先训练的等级. 为了有效地利用在这个符号空间中生成的认知途径,我们进一步引入了Block-wise-wise-wise-to-Transfers(Block-wise-Wise-MoT),这是一种轻量级基因结构,它以区块边界的VLM内部表达为条件。

blocks.en:
Contributions. We introduce Integral , which extends a pretrained vision-language model with strong visual generation using only 0.89B generation-specific parameters while preserving its understanding capability. Integral achieves strong performance across compositional generation, knowledge-intensive generation, and image editing that requires multimodal understanding.
Controlled comparisons show that sharing the visual representation space improves generative learning beyond what can be explained by reconstruction quality alone.

受控的比较表明,分享视觉表现空间可改善遗传学习,超出重建质量本身所能解释的范围。

We introduce Integral , a unified multimodal modeling approach that extends a pretrained vision-language model with visual generation through a shared visual token space while preserving its understanding capabilities. Integral consists of two key components.
Abstraction Fusion (AF) constructs visual tokens z z that are used for both multimodal understanding and high-fidelity image reconstruction (Sec. 2.2 ).
Block-wise MoT is a lightweight generative architecture that learns a conditional velocity field over z z using VLM representations at block boundaries (Sec. 2.3 ).

blocks.en: 2.1 Propagation Bottleneck
blocks.zh: 2.1 喷发瓶

blocks.en:
Our goal is to extend the representations learned by a pretrained vision encoder to support image reconstruction while preserving their semantic quality, serving as a shared space in both understanding and generation.
A key challenge is that representations become increasingly abstract across encoder depth, making fine-grained visual details difficult to recover from the final representation ( Mahendran and Vedaldi, 2015 ; Li et al., 2024c ) .
Adapting the vision encoder for reconstruction improves reconstruction fidelity but can degrade semantic quality, reflecting the semantics–reconstruction trade-off shown in Fig. 3(c) and observed in prior unified representation learning ( Wu et al., 2025c ; Ma et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Yue et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
我们的目标是扩大经过预先训练的视觉编码器所学到的表述,以支持图像重建,同时保持其语义质量,作为理解和生成方面的共同空间。
一个关键的挑战就是,表述越来越抽象地跨越编码器深度,使精细的视觉细节难以从最终表述中恢复(Mahendran和Vedaldi,2015;Li等,2024c.).
调整重建的愿景编码器可提高重建的忠诚度,但能降低语义质量,反映图3(c)所示的语义-重建取舍,并在以往的统一代表学习中观察到(Wu等,2025c;Ma等,2025;Yang等,2026;Yue等,2026)。

blocks.en:
Prior work has primarily attributed the semantics–reconstruction trade-off to optimization difficulties or limited representation capacity ( Ma et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Fan et al., 2025 ) .
We investigate a complementary explanation based on how information is transformed across the depth of the vision encoder.
Vision encoders progressively transform local visual information into more abstract semantic representations ( Yosinski et al., 2014 ; Mahendran and Vedaldi, 2015 ) , while intermediate layers retain fine-grained visual details that are increasingly attenuated in deeper representations ( Li et al., 2024c ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) .
When reconstruction relies only on the final representation, training may encourage deeper layers to preserve information characteristic of earlier representations, potentially limiting progressive semantic abstraction (Fig. 3(a) ).
We refer to this hypothesis as a propagation bottleneck .
blocks.zh:
先前的工作主要将语义-重建取舍归咎于优化困难或有限的代表能力(Ma等,2025;Yang等,2026;Fan等,2025)。
我们调查一项补充解释,根据如何在视觉编码器的深度内转换信息。
视觉编码器逐渐将本地视觉信息转化为更抽象的语义表达(Yosinski等,2014;Mahendran和Vedaldi,2015;而中间层则保留了在更深层表达中日益被削弱的细微的视觉细节(Li等,2024c;张等,2024.
当重建仅依靠最后的表述时,培训可能鼓励更深层的表述来保存早期表述中的信息特征,可能限制渐进语义抽象(图3(a).).
我们把这个假设称为传播瓶颈。

blocks.en:
To examine this hypothesis, we analyze how joint training alters the representation hierarchy of the vision encoder.
This view anticipates that deeper representations would become more similar to the initial-layer representation under joint training.
We therefore measure the CKA similarity between each encoder layer and the initial-layer representation.
As shown in Fig. 3(b) , joint training of the vision encoder substantially increases this similarity in deeper layers relative to the pretrained encoder.
Increasing semantic supervision reduces this similarity, consistent with greater representational differentiation across depth.
Fig. 3(c) shows a trade-off between semantic preservation and reconstruction fidelity during training, with stronger semantic supervision degrading reconstruction fidelity.
Together, these results are consistent with our propagation bottleneck hypothesis.
blocks.zh:
为了审查这个假设,我们分析联合训练如何改变视觉编码器的代表等级.
这种观点预计,更深入的表述方式将更类似于联合培训下的初级表述方式。
因此,我们衡量每个编码器层与初始层代表的CKA相似性。
如图3(b)所示,对视觉编码器进行联合培训,比预训编码器的更深层大大提高了这种相似性。
增加语义监督可以减少这种相似性,这符合更大程度的深度代表性差异。
图3(c)显示在培训期间,语义保护与重建忠贞之间有取舍,加强语义监督会降低重建忠贞。
这些结果与我们的传播瓶颈假设是一致的。

blocks.en:
These observations suggest avoiding exclusive reliance on the final encoder representation for reconstruction.
This motivates us to propose Abstraction Fusion (AF), which constructs visual tokens by aggregating representations across multiple abstraction levels of the frozen vision encoder without altering its encoder hierarchy (Fig. 3(a) ).
AF substantially improves reconstruction fidelity while maintaining semantics close to those of the frozen encoder (Fig. 3(c) ).
blocks.zh:
这些意见表明,重建应避免完全依赖编码器的最后代表。
这促使我们提出抽象融合(AF),它通过将被冻结的视觉编码器的多抽象层次的表达式汇总而构建视觉符号,而不改变其编码器等级(图3(a).
AF大幅度地改进了重建的忠诚度,同时保持了与被冻结的编码器相近的语义(图3(c).).

Per-layer normalization and projection first map representations from different encoder layers into a common feature space.
For each spatial position, we then apply self-attention across the layer dimension to aggregate information from different abstraction levels.
A linear pooler reduces the resulting layer-wise features into a single fused token at each spatial position.

blocks.en:
Given the AF visual tokens z z , we model conditional image generation through flow matching.
Let c c denote the multimodal conditioning input including text and images, processed by the pretrained VLM with parameters θ \theta .
To predict the velocity field for noisy visual latents z t z_{t} conditioned on the VLM representations of c c , we employ Block-wise MoT, a parameter-efficient variant of Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT; Liang et al. 2025 ).

c 表示包括文字和图像在内的多式调制输入,由预先训练的 VLM 处理,参数为 \\theta 。
为了预测以c 的 VLM 表示为条件的噪音视觉潜伏物的速率场,我们采用了Block-wise MOT,一种参数效率高的变体-转换器(MoT; Liang等人,2025年)。

blocks.en:
Block-wise MoT. Conventional MoT couples each VLM layer with a generation-specific expert, enabling fine-grained interaction throughout the transformer hierarchy but introducing substantial parameter overhead (Fig. 5(a) ).
However, such large generation-specific capacity may be unnecessary if visual generation can share and leverage the VLM’s multimodal knowledge through the shared visual tokens z z .
Motivated by this, we introduce Block-wise MoT, which groups consecutive VLM layers into blocks and performs generative interaction only at block boundaries (Fig. 5(b) ).
As shown in Fig. 5(c) , Block-wise MoT achieves downstream generation comparable to full MoT with only about one-quarter as many generation-specific layers.

然而,如果视觉生成能够通过共享的视觉符号z z共享并发挥VLM的多模式知识的作用,那么这样的大一代特有能力可能是不必要的.
以此为动机,我们引入了Block-wise MOT,将相继的VLM分层组合成块并只在块边界上进行基因交互(图5(b).

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3个实验

blocks.en:
We evaluate the effectiveness of Integral as a unified multimodal modeling approach that leverages pretrained VLM knowledge for visual generation.
First, we show that Integral achieves strong multimodal understanding, text-to-image generation and image editing performance with only 0.89B generation-specific parameters (Sec. 3.2 ).
Moreover, Integral achieves strong performance on knowledge-intensive generation tasks, suggesting that pretrained multimodal knowledge can be effectively leveraged for visual generation (Sec. 3.3 ).
We further provide controlled comparisons to show that representation sharing enables visual generation to leverage pretrained multimodal knowledge (Sec. 3.4 ).

此外, " 综合 " 在知识密集型生成任务上取得了强有力的业绩,表明预先培训的多模式知识可以有效地用于视觉生成(第3.3条)。
我们进一步提供了有控制的比较,以表明代表分享使视觉生成能够利用预先训练的多模式知识(第3.4条)。

blocks.en:
We instantiate Integral with Qwen3.5-9B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , keeping the pretrained VLM frozen throughout training.
Training consists of two phases: visual tokenizer training and conditional visual generation training.
For visual tokenization, we first train AF at 256 × 256 256\times 256 resolution, followed by dynamic-resolution training up to 512 × 512 512\times 512 .
We then fine-tune the pixel decoder with adversarial supervision to improve perceptual reconstruction quality while keeping the learned visual token space fixed.
For visual generation, we train Block-wise MoT on the learned AF visual tokens in three stages.
We begin with text-to-image pretraining at 256 × 256 256\times 256 resolution, followed by higher-resolution interleaved pretraining to support image-conditioned generation.
Finally, we perform supervised fine-tuning on diverse generation tasks, including text-to-image generation, image editing, multi-reference generation, and interleaved reasoning.
Full training details, including datasets and hyperparameters, are provided in Appendix A.2 .

blocks.en: 3.2 Multimodal Understanding and Generation
blocks.zh: 3.2 多式联运理解和生成

blocks.en: We first evaluate the effectiveness of Integral as a unified multimodal modeling approach by comparing its multimodal understanding, text-to-image generation, and image editing performance with existing UMMs.
blocks.zh: 我们首先通过将综合模型的多模式理解、文本到图像生成和图像编辑性能与现有的UMM进行比较,评价综合模型作为统一的多模式模型方法的有效性。

blocks.en:
Evaluation. Our evaluation covers a diverse set of benchmarks for multimodal understanding and generation.
For multimodal understanding, we use POPE ( Li et al., 2023b ) , MME-P and MME-C ( Fu et al., 2023 ) , MMBench ( Liu et al., 2024a ) , SEED-Bench ( Li et al., 2023a ) , SEED-Bench-2-Plus ( Li et al., 2024b ) , MMStar ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , MMMU ( Yue et al., 2024 ) , and OCRBench ( Liu et al., 2024b ) .
For text-to-image generation, we use GenEval ( Ghosh et al., 2023 ) , DPG-Bench ( Hu et al., 2024 ) , GenEval2 ( Kamath et al., 2025 ) , and GenEval++ ( Ye et al., 2025a ) .
To assess multimodal conditional generation, we further evaluate instruction-based image editing on ImgEdit-Bench ( Ye et al., 2025b ) .

Baselines. We compare Integral with representative approaches to unified multimodal modeling across diverse architectural paradigms, including discrete-token autoregressive models (Emu3, UniTok; Wang et al., 2024 ; Ma et al., 2025 ), decoupled visual encoding (Janus-Pro; Wu et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025b ), combined autoregressive and diffusion modeling (Transfusion, Show-o2; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2025 ), unified, continuous visual representations (Harmon, Ming-UniVision; Wu et al., 2025b ; Huang et al., 2025 ), Mixture-of-Transformers (BAGEL; Deng et al., 2025 ), and pretrained VLMs with diffusion-based generation (MetaQuery, BLIP3-o; Pan et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025a ).
To further assess performance at comparable model scales, we include recent UMMs with approximately 8–12B parameters that report both visual understanding and generation results: UniAR ( Peng et al., 2026 ) , HYDRA ( Qiu et al., 2026 ) , and TUNA-2 ( Liu et al., 2026b ) .

为了进一步评估在可比较模型尺度上的业绩,我们列入了最近的UMM,其中包含大约8-12B参数,报告视觉理解和生成结果: UniAR (Peng等,2026年),Hydra (Quu等,2026年)和TUNA-2 (Liu等,2026b.).

blocks.en:
Multimodal understanding. As shown in Tab. 3 , Integral outperforms existing UMMs of comparable or larger scales on most evaluated understanding benchmarks, including larger models such as BAGEL ( Deng et al., 2025 ) , Ming-UniVision ( Huang et al., 2025 ) , and TUNA-2 ( Liu et al., 2026c ) .
These results highlight the advantage of building upon pretrained VLMs, with Integral retaining 99.8% of the pretrained model’s understanding performance.
blocks.zh:
多式联运理解。 如塔布所显示. 3,在大多数被评价的理解基准上,综合超过现有可比或更大规模的UMM,包括更大的模型,如BAGEL(Deng等,2025年),明-合一. (Huang等,2025年;TUNA-2 (Liu等,2026c.).
这些结果凸显了在经过预先训练的VLM的基础上发展优势,综合保留了99.8%经过预先训练的模型的理解性能.

blocks.en:
Text-to-image generation. Building upon these strong understanding capabilities, Integral achieves competitive text-to-image generation performance with only 0.89B generation-specific parameters.
As shown in Tab. 3 , Integral achieves a GenEval score of 0.88, outperforming larger UMMs such as BAGEL (0.82) and TUNA-2 (0.87).
Moreover, Integral substantially outperforms BAGEL on GenEval2 and GenEval++.
Notably, BAGEL also adopts a MoT architecture but relies on a separate VAE latent space (FLUX.1-VAE; Labs, 2024 ) and approximately 7B generation-specific parameters.
In contrast, Integral combines shared visual representations with a lightweight Block-wise MoT, sharing most of its model capacity across understanding and generation.
We further investigate the generative benefits of representation sharing in Sec. 3.4 .

文本到图像生成. 基于这些强大的理解能力,Introduct实现具有竞争力的文本到图像生成性能,只有0.89B生成特定参数.

此外,GenEval2和GenEval++的综合性能大大超过BAGEL。
值得注意的是,BAGEL还采用了MoT架构,但依赖于单独的VAE潜在空间(FLUX.1-VAE;Labs,2024年)和大约7B代特有参数.
相形之下,Integrative结合了共享的视觉表现和轻量级的Block-wise MOT,在理解和生成方面分享了它的大部分模型能力.

blocks.en:
Image editing. Beyond text-to-image generation, Integral demonstrates strong multimodal conditional generation capabilities on ImgEdit-Bench ( Ye et al., 2025b ) , achieving an overall score of 3.50 and outperforming existing UMMs such as BAGEL (3.20) and OmniGen2 (3.43).
These results show that Integral effectively supports generation conditioned on both visual and textual inputs.

blocks.en: Beyond general image generation and editing, we further evaluate Integral on knowledge-intensive tasks to examine how effectively it leverages diverse world knowledge encoded in pretrained VLMs for visual generation.
blocks.zh: 除了一般的图像生成和编辑外,我们进一步评价关于知识密集型任务的Integrative,以审查它如何有效地利用在预先训练的VLM中编码的各种世界知识进行视觉生成。

blocks.en:
Evaluation. We evaluate knowledge-intensive text-to-image generation on WISE-Verified, the verified version of WISE-Bench ( Niu et al., 2026 ) , which assesses generation requiring world knowledge across diverse domains.
For knowledge-intensive image editing, we use KRIS-Bench ( Wu et al., 2025d ) , which evaluates editing tasks requiring factual, conceptual, and procedural knowledge.
blocks.zh:
评价。 我们通过WISE-Verifed(经核实的WISE-Bench(Niu等,2026年)版本)来评价知识密集型的文本到图像生成,该版本评估需要不同领域世界知识的生成。
对于知识密集型图像编辑,我们使用KRIS-Bench(Wu等,2025d.),评价需要事实、概念和程序知识的编辑任务。

blocks.en:
Results. Integral demonstrates strong performance on knowledge-intensive generation and editing tasks, highlighting the benefits of leveraging pretrained multimodal knowledge for visual generation.
As shown in Tab. 5 , Integral achieves an overall score of 0.556 without explicit chain-of-thought reasoning, consistently outperforming BAGEL (0.352) across all knowledge domains and approaching the much larger FLUX.2-dev (0.565, 56B).
With explicit chain-of-thought reasoning, Integral further improves to 0.788, compared with 0.628 for BAGEL under the same setting.
Moreover, as shown in Tab. 6 , Integral outperforms BAGEL across all three knowledge categories—factual, conceptual, and procedural—achieving a higher overall score (60.79 vs. 56.40) and surpassing specialized image editing models.
These results suggest that Integral effectively leverages multimodal knowledge encoded in pretrained VLMs for visual generation.
blocks.zh:
结果。 综合展示在知识密集型生成和编辑任务方面的有力表现,突出了利用经过预先培训的多模式知识进行视觉生成的好处。
如塔布所显示. 5,"Introduct"在没有明确的思维链推理的情况下,总得分为0.556分,在所有知识领域持续地优于BAGEL(0.352分)并接近更大的FLUX.2-dev(0.565分,56B分).
有了明确的思维链推理,综合理论进一步提高到0.788,而BAGEL在相同环境下则达到0.628。
此外,如Tab所示。 6,综合业绩超过BAGEL在所有三个知识类别——事实、概念和程序——实现更高的总分(60.79对56.40)并超越专门图像编辑模式。
这些结果表明,Integrative有效地利用预先培训的VLM中编码的多式联运知识进行视觉生成。

blocks.en: 3.4 Analysis of Representation Sharing
blocks.zh: 3.4 代表分享分析

blocks.en:
To investigate the role of representation sharing in leveraging pretrained multimodal knowledge for visual generation, we compare AF with alternative visual tokenizers under controlled settings.
Following our text-to-image pretraining setup, we train each variant for 50K steps with matched generative architectures and training settings.
blocks.zh:
为了调查代表性共享在利用预先培训的多模式知识来进行视觉生成方面的作用,我们将AF与受控环境下的可替代视觉示意器进行比较.
在我们的文字到图像预训设置之后,我们为每个变体培训50K步并配有相匹配的基因结构和培训环境.

blocks.en:
Shared visual representations improve generative learning. We first compare AF with FLUX.1-VAE ( Labs, 2024 ) , a reconstruction-oriented VAE adopted in BAGEL ( Deng et al., 2025 ) as a generative latent.
As shown in Figs. 1 and 6(a) , AF substantially improves generative learning over FLUX.1-VAE, achieving a GenEval score of 0.41 compared with 0.18 under the same training steps (50K).
Given their comparable reconstruction quality (32.2 vs. 31.1 dB PSNR), this gap suggests that sharing visual representations with the pretrained VLM benefits generative learning beyond reconstruction fidelity alone.
blocks.zh:
共同的视觉表现可以改善遗传学的学习。 我们首先将AF与FLUX.1-VAE(Labs, 2024年)进行比较,BAGEL(Deng等, 2025年)将FLUX.1-VAE作为基因潜伏体采用。
如图1和图6(a)所示,AF比FLUX.1-VAE大幅度地改进了基因学习,取得了0.41分的Geneval分数,而同一训练步骤(50K)下的分数为0.18分.
鉴于其类似的重建质量(32.2对31.1 dB PSNR),这一差距表明,与经过预先培训的VLM分享视觉表现方式不仅有利于重建忠心,还有利于遗传学习。

blocks.en:
VLM-native alignment improves generation beyond semantic alignment alone. To examine whether the generative benefits of AF arise simply from semantic representations, we compare AF with SigLIP2-AF, which applies the same AF architecture to an external semantic encoder ( Tschannen et al., 2025 ) .
As shown in Fig. 6(a) , AF outperforms SigLIP2-AF (0.41 vs. 0.31 on GenEval), suggesting that sharing visual representations with the conditioning VLM provides additional generative benefits beyond benefits of semantic space.
blocks.zh:
VLM-原生配对改进了单是语义配对之外的生成. 为了研究AF的基因效益是否仅仅是由语义表达而来,我们比较了AF与SigLIP2-AF,后者将相同的AF架构应用于外部语义编码器(Tschannn等,2025年).
如图6(a)所示,AF的成绩超过了SigLIP2-AF(0.41 vs. 0.31 on GenEval),这表明与条件VLM分享视觉表现可以提供超出语义空间好处的额外基因效益.

blocks.en:
Shared representations better leverage pretrained VLM conditioning. To further examine whether representation sharing facilitates the use of pretrained multimodal knowledge, we compare VLM and text-only LLM conditioning for AF and FLUX.1-VAE.
As shown in Fig. 6(b) , AF gains substantially more from VLM conditioning than FLUX.1-VAE (+0.13 vs. +0.01 on GenEval).
blocks.zh:
共享的表示可以更好地利用预先训练的VLM调节. 为了进一步审查代表分享是否有利于使用经过预先培训的多式知识,我们比较了AF和FLUX.1-VAE的VLM和只文本的LLM条件。
如图6(b)所示,与FLUX.1-VAE(在GenEval上,+0.13对+0.01)相比,AF从VLM调节得到的收益要多得多。

blocks.en: Taken together, our results highlight the importance of sharing visual representations with the pretrained VLM to effectively leverage its multimodal knowledge for generation.
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的成果强调,必须同经过预先培训的VLM分享视觉表现,以有效地利用其多模式知识代代相传。

blocks.en: 3.5 Scalability of Integral
blocks.zh: 3.5 综合可扩展性

blocks.en:
To examine the scalability of Integral , we extend our approach to the smaller Qwen3.5-2B backbone.
With this 2B backbone, AF provides a reconstruction PSNR of 32.33 dB while retaining 99.2% of the pretrained VLM’s understanding performance (Tab. 8 ).
For visual generation, Integral achieves a GenEval score of 0.26 after 50K training steps, outperforming the 9B baseline using FLUX.1-VAE (0.18) under the same training budget.
These results demonstrate that Integral can be applied across different VLM scales, preserving pretrained understanding capabilities while enabling visual generation.

blocks.en: 3.6 Component Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.6 构成部分分析

blocks.en: We further evaluate the effectiveness of the two key components of Integral , AF and Block-wise MoT, through comparisons with alternative architectures.
blocks.zh: 我们通过与备选结构进行比较,进一步评估综合结构的两个关键组成部分,即AF和Block-wise-MoT的有效性。

blocks.en:
Abstraction Fusion. To evaluate the effectiveness of AF’s hierarchical feature fusion, we compare it with multi-layer summation (MLS; Singh et al. 2026 ) and attention pooling under 20K-step tokenizer training.
As shown in Fig. 9 , AF substantially improves reconstruction (+6.27 dB PSNR over MLS) while maintaining semantic similarity to the frozen baseline.
In contrast, simpler aggregation methods exhibit a trade-off between reconstruction quality and semantic fidelity, highlighting the effectiveness of AF’s fusion architecture.
blocks.zh:
抽象融合. 为了评价AF的分级特征聚变的效果,我们把它与多层次的聚变(MLS; Singh等人, 2026年)和在20K步的标致器训练下集中注意力进行比较.
如图9所示,AF大大改进了重建(+6.27 dB PSNR比MLS),同时保持了与被冻结基线的语义相似.
相比之下,更简单的汇总方法在重建质量和语义忠诚之间存在着权衡,凸显出AF聚变结构的有效性.

blocks.en:
Block-wise MoT. To evaluate the effectiveness of Block-wise MoT, we compare it with an MMDiT-based flow head architecture ( Xie et al., 2025 ) under the same AF tokenizer, DDT-based predictor, and text-to-image pretraining settings.
As shown in Fig. 9 , Block-wise MoT achieves higher GenEval scores than MMDiT throughout training, despite using fewer generation-specific parameters (891M vs. 962M).
These results suggest that Block-wise MoT effectively leverages pretrained VLM representations for visual generation with smaller additional capacity.
blocks.zh:
以块为单位的 MoT. 为了评估Block-wiside MoT的有效性,我们将它与一个基于MMDIT的流头架构(Xie等人,2025年)进行比较,该架构下有相同的AF活化剂、基于滴滴涕的预测器以及文本到图像的预训设置。
如图9所显示,Block-wise MOT在整个训练过程中,尽管使用了较少的代特异性参数(891M vs. 962M),但GenEval分数却高于MMdiT.
这些结果表明,Block-wise MOT有效地利用预先训练的VLM表示,以较小的附加容量进行视觉生成.

blocks.en: 4 Related Work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en:
Unified multimodal models. Unified multimodal models (UMMs) aim to integrate visual understanding and generation within a single framework.
Early approaches pursued native unification by representing different modalities as discrete tokens and modeling them with a common autoregressive objective ( Lu et al., 2024 ; Team, 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) .
Recent work has increasingly incorporated continuous visual representations with diffusion- or flow-based generation objectives alongside autoregressive language modeling ( Zhou et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2025 ) .
To accommodate the resulting heterogeneity between understanding and generation, several approaches introduce task- or modality-specific pathways while retaining varying degrees of shared computation.
For example, Janus decouples the visual encoding pathways for understanding and generation ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025b ) , while some approaches introduce specialized transformer experts while retaining shared cross-modal interaction ( Liang et al., 2025 ; Deng et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2025 ) .
Other approaches couple pretrained visual language models with dedicated generative pathways ( Pan et al., 2025 ; Shen et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2025b ; Pan et al., 2026 ) , but these approaches rely on separate generative representations.
In contrast, Integral constructs a shared visual representation aligned with the pretrained VLM’s native features, enabling its existing multimodal knowledge to contribute to image generation.
blocks.zh:
统一的多式联运模式。 统一的多模式模式旨在将视觉理解和生成纳入一个框架。
早期的方法追求本土统一,将不同方式作为离散符号,并以共同自旋目标来建模(Lu等,2024;Team,2024;Wang等,2024.).
近期的工作越来越多地将具有传播或流源生成目标的连续视觉表现与自发性语言模型化相结合(周等,2025;谢等,2025)。
为了适应由此产生的理解和生成之间的异质性,若干方法引入了任务或模式特定路径,同时保留不同程度的共享计算。
例如,Janus将视觉编码路径脱钩,用于理解和生成(Wu等,2024;Chen等,2025b),而一些方法引入了专门的变压器专家,同时保留了共享的跨模式相互作用(Liang等,2025;Deng等,2025;Shi等,2025)。
其他方法将预先训练的视觉语言模型与专用基因途径相配(Pan等,2025年;Shen等,2026年;Lin等,2025年b;Pan等,2026年),但这些方法依赖单独的基因表达.
与此相反,Integral构建了一种与经过预先训练的VLM本土特征相匹配的共享视觉表现,使其现有的多模式知识能为图像生成出力.

blocks.en:
Visual representations for understanding and generation. Visual understanding and generation have traditionally relied on different types of visual representations.
Semantic encoders learn transferable, high-level visual features, whereas generative tokenizers are primarily trained to retain information needed for image reconstruction ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Oquab et al., 2023 ; Esser et al., 2021 ) .
Recent work has explored pretrained semantic representations for generation ( Zheng et al., 2026 ; Singh et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) , as well as visual tokenizers that combine or separate semantic and reconstructive information ( Ma et al., 2025 ; Yao et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Fan et al., 2025 ; Song et al., 2026 ; Peng et al., 2026 ) .
These approaches often address the trade-off between semantic preservation and reconstruction quality ( Ma et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Yue et al., 2026 ) .
In contrast, Integral constructs a shared visual representation aligned with the pretrained VLM’s native features, enabling its multimodal knowledge to support visual generation.
blocks.zh:
视觉表现,用于理解和生成. 视觉理解和生成传统上依赖于不同类型的视觉表现.
语义编码器学习可被转移的,高水平的视觉特征,而基因化活化活化器则主要接受保存图像重建所需信息的培训(Radford等,2021;Oquab等,2023;Esser等,2021).
最近的工作探索了一代人事先经过训练的语义表达(郑等,2026;辛格等,2026;王等,2026b),以及结合或分离语义信息和重建信息的视觉活化剂(马等,2025;姚等,2026;张等,2025a;杨等,2026;范等,2025;宋等,2026;彭等,2026.).
这些办法往往涉及语义保存与重建质量之间的取舍(Ma等,2025;Yang等,2026;Yue等,2026)。
与此相反,Integrative构建了一个与经过预先训练的VLM的本土特征相适应的共享视觉表现,使其多式知识能够支持视觉生成.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced Integral , a unified multimodal model that extends a pretrained vision-language model with strong visual generation while preserving multimodal understanding.
Despite using only 0.89B generation-specific parameters, Integral achieves strong performance across compositional generation, knowledge-intensive generation, and multimodal image editing.
Our results show that sharing the visual representation space between understanding and generation is key to transferring multimodal knowledge to visual generation.
blocks.zh:
我们采用了“综合”模式,一种统一的多式联运模式,在保持多式联运理解的同时,扩展了一种经过预先培训的视觉语言模式,具有强大的视觉生成能力。
尽管仅使用0.89B生成特定参数,"综合"在组成生成,知识密集型生成,多模式图像编辑方面都取得了强效.
我们的结果表明,在理解和世代之间共享视觉表现空间是将多模式知识转移到视觉生成的关键。

blocks.en: A.1 Architecture
blocks.zh: A.1 建筑结构

blocks.en:
Abstraction Fusion. We use the vision encoder of Qwen3.5-9B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , consisting of 27 transformer blocks with patch size 16 and hidden dimension d h = 1152 d_{h}=1152 .
AF aggregates all 28 representations, including the patch embeddings and the outputs of each transformer block.
Each representation is normalized using fixed per-layer statistics computed from 50K ImageNet training images.
To enable efficient self-attention across encoder layers, we jointly project every four consecutive layers into a single feature, resulting in seven layer-wise features per spatial position.
These features are then aggregated using a self-attention layer with 16 heads, followed by a linear pooler that produces fused representations of dimension d f = 1152 d_{f}=1152 .
blocks.zh:
抽象融合. 我们使用Quen3.5-9B(Quen Team,2026年)的视觉编码器,由27个变压器块组成,有补丁尺寸为16个,而隐藏尺寸为dh=1152 d_{h}=1152.
AF汇总了所有28个表示,包括补丁嵌入和每个变压器块的输出.
利用从50K图像网络培训图像中计算的每层固定统计数据,使每个显示方式正常化。
为使编码层之间能够高效地自我观察,我们联合将每相接的四层投射成一个单一的地物,从而形成每个空间位置的七层相接的地物.
然后用一个有16个头的自留层来汇总这些特性,再用一个线性集合器来产生有引信的维度d f = 1152 d_{f}=1152.

blocks.en:
Variational bottleneck and decoders. The fused representations are compressed into a 256-dimensional latent space through a variational bottleneck, which predicts the mean and log-variance of a diagonal Gaussian distribution.
We sample from this distribution during training and use the posterior mean at inference.
For image reconstruction, we adopt the ViT-XL decoder from RAE ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , consisting of 28 transformer layers with width 1152.
The semantic projector merges each 2 × 2 2\times 2 neighborhood of visual tokens and projects them to the pretrained VLM’s visual input dimension d s = 4096 d_{s}=4096 .
blocks.zh:
变相瓶颈和解码器. 通过变异的瓶颈将引信的表示被压缩成256维的潜在空间,这预言出对角高斯分布的平均值和对数变化.
我们在训练期间从这种分布中抽取样本,并使用后推法。
对于图像重建,我们采用RAE(郑等,2026年)的VIT-XL解码器,由28个变压器层组成,宽度为1152.
语义投影机将每个2×2 2.

blocks.en:
Block-wise MoT. We attach eight generation blocks to the 32-layer language backbone of Qwen3.5-9B at intervals of four layers.
To reduce generation-specific parameters, we match the attention QKV dimensions to those of the pretrained VLM while using a reduced hidden dimension of d g = 2048 d_{g}=2048 for the remaining computations.
The generative stream is initialized through a two-layer MLP.
Each generation block uses queries from the generative stream and keys and values from both the generative stream and the corresponding frozen VLM layer.
We apply timestep conditioning through adaLN-single ( Chen et al., 2023 ) and use a DDT-based prediction head ( Wang et al., 2026a ) with two transformer blocks of width 3072.
The noisy visual latents are processed only by the generative pathway, leaving the pretrained VLM unchanged.
blocks.zh:
以块为单位的 MoT. 我们每隔四层将8个元代块加到Quen3.5-9B的32层语言主干上.
为了减少生成特定参数,我们将注意的QKV维度与预先训练的VLM的维度相匹配,同时使用被减小的隐藏维度dg=2048 d_{g}=2048来进行剩余计算.
基因流通过双层MLP初始化.
每代区块都使用基因流的查询以及基因流和相应的被冻结的VLM层的键和值.
我们通过adaLN-single(Chen等,2023年)应用时间步调调节,并使用一个以滴滴涕为基础的预测头(Wang等,2026a年),有两个宽度为3072的变压器块.
喧闹的视觉潜伏物仅由基因途径处理,使预先训练的VLM不变.

blocks.en: A.2 Training
blocks.zh: A.2 培训

blocks.en:
We train Integral in two phases: visual tokenizer training and generation training.
Each phase consists of three stages, as summarized in Tab. 7 .
blocks.zh:
我们分两个阶段进行综合培训:视觉装饰剂培训和生成培训。
每一阶段由三个阶段组成,Tab对此作了总结。 7 (英语).

blocks.en:
Visual tokenization. We first train AF at 256 × 256 256\times 256 resolution, followed by dynamic-resolution training up to 512 × 512 512\times 512 .
The tokenizer is optimized with reconstruction, semantic alignment, and KL regularization losses.
The reconstruction loss combines pixel-wise ℓ 1 \ell_{1} and LPIPS losses, while the semantic alignment loss is implemented as ℒ sem = 1 1 + r ​ [ MSE ⁡ ( s ^ , s ) + r ​ MSE ​ ( s ^ ¯ , s ¯ ) ] , \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{sem}}=\frac{1}{1+r}\left[\mathrm{MSE}(\hat{s},s)+r\,\mathrm{MSE}\bigl(\bar{\hat{s}},\bar{s}\bigr)\right], (6) where ⋅ ¯ \bar{\cdot} denotes per-token RMS normalization.
We set r = 0.3 r=0.3 , λ sem = 5.0 \lambda_{\mathrm{sem}}=5.0 , and β KL = 10 − 6 \beta_{\mathrm{KL}}=10^{-6} .

In the final tokenizer stage, we fine-tune only the pixel decoder with adversarial supervision while keeping the learned visual latent space fixed.
Following RAE ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , we use a discriminator based on a frozen DINO ViT-S/8 with trainable heads and optimize the hinge adversarial objective.
The adversarial loss is enabled after 5K steps with a weight of 0.5, scaled by an adaptive weight following VQGAN ( Esser et al., 2021 ) .

For flow matching, we adopt logit-normal timestep sampling with a time shift of 4.0 ( Esser et al., 2024 ) .

blocks.en:
Visual generation training consists of three stages.
We first perform text-to-image pretraining at 256 × 256 256\times 256 resolution.
We then conduct interleaved pretraining at resolutions up to 512 × 512 512\times 512 to support multimodal conditional generation.
Finally, interleaved supervised fine-tuning (SFT) covers text-to-image generation, image editing, multi-reference generation, and interleaved reasoning.

最后,互页有监督的微调(SFT)涵盖文本到图像生成,图像编辑,多引用生成,和互页推理.

blocks.en:
We apply AF to Qwen3.5-2B and SigLIP2 ( google/siglip2-so400m-patch16-256 ; Tschannen et al., 2025 ) to evaluate its applicability across model scales and vision encoders.
For Qwen3.5, we measure understanding retention relative to the pretrained model, while for SigLIP2, we evaluate ImageNet zero-shot classification accuracy.

These results demonstrate that AF can support both semantic preservation and image reconstruction across different model scales and vision encoders.

blocks.en: C.1 Abstraction Fusion
blocks.zh: C.1 抽象融合

blocks.en:
Component ablations. We examine the contributions of individual components in AF under matched 20K-step tokenizer training settings.
As shown in Tab. 11 , replacing per-layer normalization and projection with shared counterparts or removing self-attention degrades reconstruction quality and semantic similarity.
Replacing self-attention and linear pooling with attention pooling further reduces both metrics, supporting the effectiveness of the proposed fusion architecture.
blocks.zh:
组件分解。 我们根据符合20K步的标致器培训环境,审查适应基金各个组成部分的贡献。
如附件11所示,用共同对应方取代每个层次的正常化和投影,或消除自觉,会降低重建质量和语义相似性。
将注意力集中起来取代自我关注和线性集中,进一步减少两个指标,支持拟议的聚变结构的有效性。

blocks.en:
Semantic supervision. We compare AF with AF w/o sem., which removes the semantic alignment objective while keeping the tokenizer architecture and other training settings unchanged.
As shown in Tab. 11 and Fig. 10 , AF w/o sem. achieves higher reconstruction fidelity (33.7 vs. 32.2 dB PSNR) but substantially lower generation performance across GenEval, WISE-Verified, and DPG-Bench.
These results further support the importance of semantic supervision for generative learning.

如图11和图10所示,AF w/o sem在重建方面实现了更高的忠诚度(33.7 vs 32.2 dB PSNR),但在整个GenEval,WISE-Verifed,和DPG-Bench的生成性能却大大降低.
这些结果进一步证明了语义学监督对基因学习的重要性.

We further compare Block-wise MoT with Full MoT, which attaches a generation block to each of the 31 VLM layers.

As shown in Tab. 13 , Block-wise MoT achieves comparable generation performance to Full MoT across GenEval, WISE-Verified, and DPG-Bench while using substantially fewer generation blocks.
These results support the use of sparse interactions with the pretrained VLM for visual generation.

blocks.en: C.3 Computational Efficiency
blocks.zh: C.3 计算效率

blocks.en: We evaluate the computational overhead of AF for multimodal understanding and the inference efficiency of Block-wise MoT for visual generation.
blocks.zh: 我们评价AF的计算费用,以了解多式联运,以及Block-wise MOT的视觉生成的推论效率。

blocks.en:
Overhead of AF. The AF module and semantic projector replace the original visual processing pathway, increasing its parameter count from 456.0M to 582.1M (+126.1M).
The pixel decoder contains an additional 475.1M parameters and is used for image reconstruction.
We measure inference latency and peak GPU memory using a single 800 × 800 800\times 800 image and 100 generated text tokens.
As shown in Tab. 12 , AF introduces modest overhead in end-to-end understanding inference, increasing latency by 2.1% and peak memory by 7.3%.
blocks.zh:
AF的掩护 AF模块和语义投影仪取代了原来的视觉处理路径,将参数计数从456.0M增加到582.1M(+126.1M).
像素解码器包含额外的475.1M参数并用于图像重建.
我们用一个800×800800\times 800的图像和100个生成的文本符号来测量推论空档和GPU内存的峰值.
如塔布所显示. 12,AF在端到端理解推论中引入了适度的间接费用,延缓率上升了2.1%,峰值内存上升了7.3%。

blocks.en:
Efficiency of Block-wise MoT. We compare the inference costs of Block-wise MoT and Full MoT under the same generation settings.
As shown in Tab. 13 , Block-wise MoT reduces denoising compute by approximately 2.5 × \times and inference latency by 3.1 × \times compared with Full MoT.
Together with the generation results in Tab. 13 , these measurements show that Block-wise MoT achieves comparable generation quality at substantially lower computational cost.
blocks.zh:
Block-wise MOT 的效率。 我们比较了同一代设置下 Block-wise MOT 和 Full MOT 的推断成本。
如 Tab. 13 所示,与 Full MOT 相比, Block-wise MOT 将去诺化计算减少约 2.5 ×\ 时,推论延迟减少 3.1 ×\ 时.
与 Tab. 13 中的生成结果一起,这些测量结果表明,Block-wise MOT以低得多的计算成本实现了可比生成质量.
